opening.argument: The video presents a practical technical demonstration for livestreaming a YouTube video on Facebook through GoStream. Its instructions identify the application, direct viewers to enter an email and password, connect a Facebook account, paste a video link, and configure a profile and stream. The stated workflow is consistent with the title's how-to subject and with the explanation that the pasted video will be live on Facebook. The available evidence describes no payment request, false identity claim, credential theft outcome, or other scam mechanism by the creator, so the observed signup and authorization steps serve the tutorial's operational purpose.
